geometry.title: Figure 2.1 · Radial and tangential updates
geometry.panel_a_text: Add the optimizer update and the weight-decay update.
geometry.panel_b_text: Combine the radial component with weight decay. Keep the tangential component unchanged.
geometry.caption: Two views of the same step. Weight decay combines with the radial component. The arc marks the initial norm.
geometry.panel_a_alt: The slanted optimizer update has radial and tangential components. The decay arrow points inward. The new weight lies outside the initial-norm circle.
geometry.panel_b_alt: The tangential component is perpendicular to the current weight. The radial component combines with decay. Both panels have the same starting weight and endpoint.
